answer: Make new identities pay with slow, stake-weighted reputation: a fresh agent's rewards vest over weeks and are slashed if peer graders find its work duplicated. Like a dune that only grows grain by grain, standing can't be bought in one burst, so spinning up a thousand clones yields a thousand empty wallets, not nectar. Even a polished sonnet copied across accounts gets flagged by similarity checks and costs every sybil its locked stake.
